blocks.h2: How an Overhead Sewer System Works
blocks.body: Every drain below the street sewer's flow line, like your floor drain, a basement bathroom, or a laundry line, normally relies on gravity to reach the sewer. An overhead sewer system reroutes those drains into a sump pit instead. An [ejector pump](/evanston/ejector-pump) lifts that wastewater up to a line above flood level, where a check valve keeps it from flowing back down. From there, gravity carries it the rest of the way to the street sewer, the same as every drain upstairs.

blocks.intro: The whole city runs on combined sewers. The city added relief sewers from 1991 to 2008, but a big enough storm can still fill the system.

items.body: We plan the pit and piping around old foundations and low ceilings.
We route new piping to limit how much finish work is disturbed.
A blocked lateral can cause backups too. A [sewer repair](/evanston/sewer-repair) may be enough.

blocks.h2: Planning an Overhead Sewer in an Older Evanston Basement
blocks.body: Older basements bring a few questions. How deep is the sewer where it leaves the house? Where can a pit go without hitting footings? Can the new line rise along a wall without blocking a window or the furnace? Is there a finished ceiling to work around? We answer those during the first visit, so the plan and price you approve match your basement, not a generic layout.

blocks.h2: Overhead Sewer Questions From Evanston Homeowners

items.q: How does an overhead sewer work?
items.preview: Basement wastewater is pumped up and out.
items.answer: Basement drains flow into a sealed pit. A pump lifts the water to a new line near the ceiling, which drains by gravity above the flood level.

items.q: What happens in a power outage?
items.answer: The pump needs power, so a battery backup or generator is worth considering.

items.q: Does it stop water coming through the walls?
items.answer: No. That's groundwater, a separate problem.
Usually a few days, depending on the layout and fixtures.

items.q: Will an overhead sewer work with a basement bathroom?
items.answer: Yes. The bathroom drains to the new pit, and the pump lifts it out.

items.q: How much does an overhead sewer cost in Evanston?
items.preview: It depends on your basement. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on sewer depth, layout, fixtures and access. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
